title: How do you {job} today? A 5-minute research survey
description: A short research survey about how people {job} today: what triggers it, what you use, and what gets in the way.
audience: People who have {job_past} in the last 3 months
purpose: Decide whether the need to {job} is frequent and painful enough to build for, and which unmet need (speed, cost, accuracy, ease, sharing) to solve first

welcome.title: How do you {job} today?
welcome.description:
We're the {team} at {company}. We're learning how people {job}, so that anything we build fits the way you already work. Nothing is being sold here.
• Takes about 5 minutes
• Your answers are only seen by the {team} and reported in summary
• Taking part is voluntary; you can stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you, that's everything
thank_you.description: Your answers shape what we build. If you agreed to a follow-up call, we'll email you within a week. We'll share a summary of what we learned within a month of {date}. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: Have you {job_past} in the last 3 months?
How many times have you {job_past} in the last 3 months?
The most recent time, which of these did you use to get it done? Select all that apply.
options: Someone else did it for me
An outside service I paid for

questions.label: Overall, how satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the way you handle this today?
Thinking about the most recent time, what was happening that made you need to do it?
questions.description: The situation, the trigger, the deadline: whatever comes to mind.

questions.label: What is the most frustrating part of how you handle this today?
When you do this, how important is each of these to you?
rows: Getting it right the first time
Not having to learn anything new

questions.label: Have you paid for a product or service to help with this in the last 12 months?
Roughly how much have you spent on it in the last 12 months?
questions.description: In {currency}, in total. A rough figure is fine.

questions.label: If you could improve one thing about how you do this, what would it be?
Who do you usually do this for?
questions.description: So we can compare personal and work needs.

questions.label: Would you be open to a 20-minute follow-up call about this?
Which email address can we use to arrange the call?
questions.description: We'll use it only to schedule the call.
